title: DeadLetterReason
description: Structured payload written to the Service Bus dead-letter reason property when a message is dead-lettered by the processing function.

dataset_id.description: Dataset identifier from the event payload, if extractable.

fail_count.description: Number of validation failures. Present only when error_type is ValidationFailed.

failures.description: First 10 validation failure details. Present only when error_type is ValidationFailed.

detected_encoding.description: Detected encoding of the rejected file. Present only when error_type is UnsupportedEncoding.
